h1: Run Your Malawian Business on Autopilot with Ceyo
sub: Deploy dedicated AI agents that research markets, write code, and coordinate operations around the clock from your Telegram chat, even when your device goes offline.
audience: Agribusiness exporters, freight logistics coordinators, Blantyre merchants, Lilongwe consulting firms, and software developers across Malawi.
manifesto: When erratic power cuts and fluctuating connectivity disrupt daily operations, Ceyo keeps working in secure cloud computers, ensuring Malawian businesses execute market research, customer workflows, and scheduled reporting without interruption.

uses.d: Bots monitor regional tea, tobacco, and macadamia auction reports, compiling pricing trends into shared spreadsheets automatically.
Agents track transit documentation and regional logistics portals connecting Blantyre to Beira and Nacala trade corridors.
Write, execute, and host functional web applications directly in the cloud computer without requiring expensive local workstations.
Summarize complex donor documentation, monitor compliance schedules, and generate structured grant briefs using persistent bot memory.
Handle international lodge reservations, guest itineraries, and automated email responses via voice, text, or connected messaging tools.
Deploy autonomous browser agents to gather wholesale machinery and inventory quotes across Southern African commerce platforms.

steps.d: Begin your 3-day free trial on Plus, Pro, or Ultra with instant access to 1,000,000 daily tokens.
Connect your preferred tools from over 1,000 apps and add your personal agents to Telegram.
Assign coding, web browsing, and research routines that run uninterrupted inside isolated cloud computers.

chapters.d: Wake up to a consolidated regional market report gathered overnight by your cloud browser while your phone was switched off.
Direct your specialist bots in a Telegram group chat to draft proposals, balance ledgers, and check order statuses simultaneously.
Your agent accesses procurement websites, fills complex forms, and compiles competitive supplier bids without manual oversight.
Scheduled cloud routines continuously audit code and refresh database records regardless of local load-shedding or network drops.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and what does the free trial include?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three plans: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan begins with a 3-day free trial offering up to 1,000,000 tokens per day, with card verification required upon signup and billing starting only after the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Will my Ceyo bots keep working during power or internet outages in Malawi?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo bot runs on its own isolated cloud computer in a secure data center, meaning your scheduled routines, web scrapers, and coding agents continue operating around the clock even if your local power or mobile data disconnects.

faq.q: How do I interact with my bots via Telegram?
faq.a: You can message your personal Ceyo bot directly or create Telegram group chats where multiple specialist bots collaborate as a unified team, answering questions, processing data, and executing tasks together.

faq.q: What languages do Ceyo agents support?
faq.a: Ceyo communicates natively in English, Chichewa, and hundreds of other world languages, allowing you to converse, analyze documents, and draft customer responses in the language that best fits your audience.

faq.q: Can Ceyo connect with my existing business software?
faq.a: Yes. Ceyo integrates with more than 1,000 popular applications including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, calendars, and major CRM systems, enabling your bots to read and update records autonomously.
